title: Waffle: AI builder for desktop / mobile games
author: manuj_w
selftext:
Hi I'm Manuj, founder of [Waffle](https://waffle.ai) \- a new AI game builder. You can create games by prompting the AI or editing the code directly. People have already published Waffle games to [itch.io](http://itch.io) and entered them into game jams.

The game below is a Rick & Morty themed puzzle game that 2 non-coders created for a week-long jam using Waffle (shoutout to Toxic and Robert!).

We launched just 2 months ago and have started to build a really cool community. I'd love to hear your thoughts about Waffle ([https://waffle.ai](https://waffle.ai)), and what we can do to improve it. You can dm me on discord any time at manuj25 or join our server here - [https://discord.gg/tSPfRgUey6](https://discord.gg/tSPfRgUey6).
